# Phantom Sky Imaging

> FAA Part 107 certified drone photography and videography for real estate listings, roofing inspections, commercial inspections, events, and storm damage assessments. Serving Southeast Pennsylvania.

## Business

Phantom Sky Imaging is a licensed commercial drone operator serving Southeast Pennsylvania — including Chester County, Delaware County, Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the greater Philadelphia area.

- **Phone:** (484) 684-0579
- **Email:** joshuasaylor@phantomskyimaging.com
- **Website:** https://phantomskyimaging.com
- **Service Area:** Southeast Pennsylvania (Chester, Delaware, Montgomery, Bucks, Philadelphia counties)

## Credentials

- FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate (commercial drone operations)
- Fully insured for all commercial flights

## Services

### Real Estate Photography
High-resolution aerial still photography for real estate listings. Delivers MLS-ready edited JPEG images including golden hour scheduling, twilight shots, and full property footprint coverage. 48-hour turnaround.

### Real Estate Video
Cinematic HD aerial video tours for real estate listings and marketing. Professionally color-graded with licensed music. Social media cuts included. 48-hour delivery.

### Roofing Inspection Video
Detailed aerial video documentation for roofing contractors, insurance adjusters, and property managers. Covers full perimeter, ridge lines, valleys, flashing details, and damage areas. Timestamped footage with PDF summary report available. Insurance claim-ready deliverables.

### Commercial Inspection
Comprehensive aerial inspection for commercial properties, warehouses, and large-scale facilities. Documents structural conditions, HVAC units, signage, and parking lots safely from above. Timestamped HD footage and insurance-ready reports.

### Events Coverage
Cinematic aerial footage for outdoor festivals, community gatherings, sporting events, and corporate functions. Captures the full scale and energy of events from above with highlight reel delivery.

### Storm Damage Assessment
Rapid aerial documentation after severe weather events. Same-day or next-day response available. Provides safe documentation of wind and fallen tree damage for homeowners, contractors, and insurance adjusters. Timestamped HD video delivery and insurance claim-ready footage.

## Pricing

- Real Estate Photography: $150 (Starter, 10 aerials) / $200 (Standard, 20 aerials) / $250 (Premium, 25+ aerials)
- Video Add-On: +$125 (60-sec) / +$175 (90-sec with social cuts)
- Roofing Inspection: $200 (video only) / $275 (video + PDF report)

## Process

1. **Request & Scope** — Submit a project inquiry with property details
2. **Schedule & Plan** — Coordinate shoot date, airspace checks, weather windows
3. **Fly & Capture** — FAA-compliant shoot with full coverage
4. **Edit & Deliver** — Edited files delivered via download link within 48 hours
